# Pull Request

🇫🇷 **Français** | 🇬🇧 **English**

---

## 📝 Description

Description claire des changements / Clear description of changes.

## 🔗 Issue liée / Related issue

Closes #(issue)

## 🎯 Type de changement / Type of change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to not work)
- [ ] 📖 Documentation update
- [ ] 🔧 Refactoring (no functional changes)

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] Mon code suit le style du projet / My code follows the project style
- [ ] J'ai testé localement / I have tested locally
- [ ] J'ai mis à jour la documentation / I have updated the documentation
- [ ] J'ai mis à jour les deux versions (FR/EN) / I have updated both versions (FR/EN)
- [ ] J'ai ajouté des tests si nécessaire / I have added tests if necessary
- [ ] Tous les tests passent / All tests pass

## 🧪 Tests effectués / Tests performed

- [ ] Build Docker réussi / Docker build successful
- [ ] Test avec HA version X.X.X
- [ ] Test auth mode: `home_assistant`
- [ ] Test auth mode: `api_secret`
- [ ] Test auth mode: `both`

## 📸 Captures d'écran / Screenshots

Si applicable / If applicable.

## 🌐 Contexte additionnel / Additional context

Toute autre information pertinente / Any other relevant information.
